# UNHELD

> %UNHELD_DESCRIPTION%

UNHELD is made by Siri (Asiri) Dalugoda. It is played in the browser as The Quiet Works: a corridor built around 1910, whose mismatched department doors each open onto one room. It runs in any WebGL2 browser on desktop or phone, and everything in it can also be read in text mode (https://unheld.space/?mode=text). It is an artwork, not a support service: nothing is scored, and there are no accounts, cookies, analytics or advertising. Code: Apache License 2.0. Original art and writing: CC BY 4.0. The UNHELD name and mark are not licensed.

## Open rooms

New rooms available: The Tomorrow Engine and The Exchange.
